# Information Security Baseline

**Owner:** Chief Information Security Officer
**Review cadence:** Annual

## 1. Purpose
This baseline establishes the minimum security controls required across
organizational information systems.

## 2. Access Control
System access is limited to authorized users, processes, and devices.
Accounts are provisioned on a least-privilege basis and reviewed quarterly.

## 3. Identification and Authentication
Multifactor authentication is required for all network and remote access.

## 4. Risk Assessment
Risk to organizational operations and assets is assessed periodically, and
security controls are adjusted to remain appropriate to the assessed risk.

## 5. System Security Plan
A system security plan documenting these controls is maintained and
approved by management.
